info.name: BeliefState: investor research API
info.description: Explore free research discovery, current input/output contracts and unpaid x402 payment quotes. Hosted research reads require account access or an explicitly authorized wallet payment. Account MCP: https://beliefstate.ai/mcp. Wallet MCP: https://beliefstate.ai/v1/research/mcp. Setup: https://beliefstate.ai/agent-quickstart.md. This collection contains no payment signer or credentials.
